info.description:
Marketplace backend for small merchants in Addis Ababa: storefronts, carts,
escrow-backed checkout through Chapa, and Blnk-powered merchant wallets.
info.title: Gebeya API

post.description: Creates the merchant's Blnk wallet if it has none (seeded merchants, or onboarding while Blnk was down). Safe to repeat.
release pays the merchant as if delivery were confirmed; refund cancels the order and refunds the buyer through Chapa (set restock when the goods came back).

post.description: Rejects a pending payout and releases the held funds back to the merchant's wallet

get.description: Compares every merchant wallet and the escrow balance in Blnk with Postgres records. Also runs daily at 03:00 Addis Ababa time.

post.description: Texts a 6-digit code (Amharic and English) to the phone on the account. One request per minute.
Confirms the code sent by SMS and marks the phone number verified. Required before checkout and opening a shop.
Sets a new password and signs the account out everywhere.
Texts a reset code if the phone belongs to an account. Always answers 202 so it cannot reveal which numbers are registered.
